claim: Let \(P\) be the five-element poset with two incomparable minimal elements, both below a chain of three elements. For every integer \(n\ge4\), its induced saturation number satisfies \(n+2\le \operatorname{sat}^*(n,P)\le2n+2\); consequently \(\operatorname{sat}^*(n,P)=\Theta(n)\).
integrity: The upper bound is proved directly by an explicit family and a complete saturation argument. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim proves linear order only; it does not determine the exact saturation number or optimal leading constant. The lower bound is an application of the published legs theorem.
title: Linear induced saturation for a five-point layered poset
